title: Applicability of Syncope Guidelines in Cataluña
brief_summary: The aim of SYNCAT study is to study the level of adherence of the centers in Cataluña tu the Syncope Guidelines ESC2009 for the diagnosis and treatment of syncope and the impact that following them can have in the prognosis of these patients.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Each patient that comes from the Emergency room and/or in office doctors visit (Internal Medicine, Cardiology, Neurology...) with Transient Loss of Conscience (T-LOC)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients younger than 15 years old
* Pregnant women
study_population: Patients with Transient Loss of Conscience: T-LOC
